insight: Pivoted out of Mendable (AI doc-chat used by Snapchat, MongoDB); a YC S22 company that raised $14.5M in 2025.
name: Firecrawl
tagline: Turn any website into clean, LLM-ready data — scrape, crawl, search.
description: A web data API for AI — scrape, crawl, map, and search pages into clean markdown or structured JSON, handling proxies, anti-bot, and JS rendering for you. Open-source core (AGPL) plus a hosted service; a default web-ingestion layer for agents and RAG pipelines.
edge: Returns clean LLM-ready markdown (not raw HTML), handles JS + anti-bot, and its AGPL core can be self-hosted.
pros: Manages proxies and JS rendering for you
Scrape, crawl, map, search in one API
cons: Heavy sites can still need tuning
